title: Us vs. Them: A Dataset of Populist Attitudes, News Bias and Emotions

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the level of discrimination, critical attitudes, and emotional valence in Reddit comments directed at political groups (Liberals, Conservatives), as well as evaluating how these attitudes correlate with the political bias (e.g., left, center, right) of the news sources linked in the posts.

Measuring supportive versus discriminatory language and fine-grained emotions (e.g., fear, anger, contempt) in social media comments specifically targeting religious groups (Muslims, Jews) within the context of populist out-group discourse.
Annotating and training multi-task learning models to predict the degree of discrimination and emotional sentiment in Reddit comments aimed at immigrants and refugees.
